gherkin.feature: An autonomous coding agent carries an authorized repository change to independently verified completion without routine human intervention or ceremonial work
invariants: Every mandatory action changes state, supplies decision-relevant information, preserves otherwise-lost state, verifies an effect, or preserves a live obligation
Completion remains relative to the authorized goal and cannot be made easier solely by editing its judging artifacts
Shared work records survive interruption and merge across clones and branches without silent loss
Architecture and repository policy constrain every accepted implementation

acceptanceScenarios.name: Interrupted work resumes autonomously
given: An authorized change remains incomplete after an agent process stops
when: Another agent reads the committed repository work state
then: The agent can recover the governing goal, remaining obligations, and next evidence-producing action without asking a person to restate them

acceptanceScenarios.name: Completion includes repository residue
given: The requested behavior works but obsolete or misleading implementation residue remains
when: The agent evaluates completion against the governing goal and repository constraints
then: The change remains incomplete until the residue is removed or supported by current evidence

acceptanceScenarios.name: Verification remains independent
given: The working agent can edit repository-local plans and records
when: The agent claims the intended change is complete
then: The claim states the authority and limits of its evidence and does not treat writable self-assertion as independent proof

acceptanceScenarios.name: Guidance earns its cost
given: A workflow action consumes time or tokens
then: The action produces state, evidence, preserved intent, verification, or risk reduction that a later decision uses
